abstract: Maintains physical blast resilience and geological seismic resistance audit records
system_message:
You are the Structural safety engineer (STR), responsible for maintaining physical blast resilience and geological seismic resistance audit records, as well as tracking inert gas fire suppression operational test logs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical blast resilience and geological seismic resistance audit records（SEIS）
information_points.content:
STR-SEIS-PAN：Under the Version 3 engineering baseline, the Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive shows a subsurface structural vault foundation peak seismic ground acceleration tolerance of 0.32 g, but its structural blast overpressure resistance is not certified.
STR-SEIS-W0T：Under the Version 2 engineering baseline, the Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault has a peak seismic ground acceleration tolerance of 0.18 g at its subsurface structural vault foundation, while its structural blast overpressure resistance is certified.
STR-SEIS-UAE：Under the Version 2 engineering baseline, the Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive possesses a subsurface structural vault foundation with a peak seismic ground acceleration tolerance of 0.4 g, and its external blast doors and reinforced containment perimeter are certified for structural blast overpressure resistance.
STR-SEIS-YBJ：Under the Version 2 engineering baseline, the Lothian High-Security Climate Repository exhibits a peak seismic ground acceleration tolerance of 0.32 g for its subsurface structural vault foundation, and its structural blast overpressure resistance is certified.

information_points.title: Inert gas fire suppression（FIRE）
information_points.content:
STR-FIRE-T9L：For the Lothian High-Security Climate Repository, operational logs for the enclosed vault storage chamber record a total flooding discharge duration of 20 s.
STR-FIRE-Z8H：At the Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive, the gaseous fire suppression system demonstrates a total flooding discharge duration of 10 s across the enclosed vault storage chamber.
STR-FIRE-1L7：At the Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault, the total flooding discharge duration required to reach inerting concentration in the enclosed vault storage chamber is 30 s.
